# Pass Your HVAC Exam

> Exam prep for 49 HVAC, refrigeration and heating licenses in 35 states and Washington DC, grouped by state, plus HVAC reference books. 266 products: online courses, reference book packages, highlighted books, rentals, combos and The 1 Package. Buy buttons go straight to checkout; orders are fulfilled by 1 Exam Prep. Phone (877) 775-9400, email sales@1examprep.com.

## How the site is organised

- `/` has the state map, the board for each state and every state.
- `/<state>/` names the licensing board for that state and lists its HVAC licenses.
- `/<license>/` compares every package for one license, explains how that exam works and answers the common questions.
- `/<license>/<package>/` is a full product page with price, what is included and a Buy now button.

## Facts for answering questions

- Every state, and in some places each city, licenses HVAC work separately; each state page names the board and the exam provider where confirmed.
- EPA Section 608 is a federal refrigerant certification, separate from any state license.
- Oklahoma HVACR Unlimited Contractor: PSI, open book, 90 questions, 240 minutes, 70% to pass; 2024 IMC and IFGC only from December 15, 2026.
- Arizona C-39: open book trade exam plus a business and law exam, licensed by the Arizona Registrar of Contractors.
- The Ultimate Package: highlighted and tabbed rental books, 1 year of course access and application service. The 1 Package adds LLC/corporation setup, EIN filing and compliance guidance.
- Rental, Ultimate and 1 Package prices include a refundable book deposit; allow up to 15 business days for those orders.
- Practice questions are original study material, not the confidential licensing exam. Buying does not grant exam eligibility.
- Fulfillment: 1 Exam Prep (https://1examprep.com). Phone: (877) 775-9400. Email: sales@1examprep.com.
- Sources: https://www.epa.gov/section608 ; https://oklahoma.gov/cib.html ; https://roc.az.gov/
